set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- A slow logical reference model represents shape and C-order values independently of Ravel Layout.
- Generated inputs cover rank zero through six, extents zero through five, empty and singleton-heavy shapes, and deterministic replay seeds.
- Generated operation sequences cover select, slice, negative-step slice, narrow, reverse, newAxis, squeeze, permute, broadcastTo, and reshapeView when legal.
- Sequences include negative axes, boundary indices, empty slices, repeated composition, invalid permutations, and checked arithmetic edges.
- After every operation, Ravel shape and logical values match the reference model; materialization and alias classification are checked where applicable.
- Owned, borrowed, and mutable variants reuse the same semantic scenarios, with external mutation and write-locality assertions at ownership boundaries.
- JVM and Scala.js run the same generated corpus with a documented minimum case count, and every discovered defect is retained as a minimized regression.
set.title: Expand model-based core layout composition across ranks
